Actual-mu floors/energy/stress/residual tests against original1000Pa behavior and homogeneity algebra, without generating native logs or claiming empirical fitted behavior.

interpretation: New branch qualification permits descriptive one-specimen fitting within user authorization; original failed aggregate receipts remain unchanged. Conditional spatial screens/mixed-step sensitivity are not rigorous continuum accuracy or empirical material calibration. Held-out positive/negative torsion are branches of the same specimen, not independent subjects. Report fixed RMSE/MAE/normalizedRMSE/endpoint/work/symmetry as originally defined, including agreement or disagreement; no invented clinical or physical binary threshold. No patient-specific material, instrument contact/retraction/cutting/damage/injury or vascular/fluid validation follows.
minimal_code_reuse: Keep all historical helpers immutable. New access subclass reuses unchanged ledger chronology, exact member parser/roles and schema checks, but exact new release provenance/reference map, numerical freeze dispatch and file-cap registry must be explicit. Existing fit_scale/interpolate/quadrature/scale_prediction/paired_metrics, fitted-deck guard, backend transformation, raw parsers, HexMesh math, reflection map and supervision are reused. No new physical engine or copied whole temporal/original experiment runner.

stages: Bind actual reference results/independent qualifications before opening only two authorized axial calibration members. Compute unchanged common-positive fit_scale once; save fit and stop on invalid/nonpositive/unidentified scale.
Prepare and run actual fitted compression then tension once each; retain native receipts even on failure. Before each next stage check remaining inclusive time/output limits.

For each branch stream reference/fitted node+element+solver logs in lockstep for all121 states; one model geometry, two transient frames. Independently reconstruct/evaluate both at their actualmu; reproduce saved reference numerical readout and compute fitted individual+scale maxima. Do not retain121 full nodal arrays or replay all historical grids.

The paired pass supplies the independent primitive evidence used by freeze; combine validation and evidence construction instead of an earlier redundant readout followed by the same full replay. Bind its source and exact inputs; save criteria before evaluating pass; rehash inputs at freeze and before reveal. No summary-only or boolean substitute for either actual fitted confirmation.

After both actual confirmations pass, recompute saved fit from in-memory originally read calibration and bound branch references; save two N12 torsion scaled predictions and durable parameter/prediction freeze. Conditional authorized held-out read only after audited freeze; expose original metrics/curves.
